name: MAI Code 2 Flash
archDisplay: Decoder-only transformer with sparse Mixture-of-Experts layers and an integrated vision encoder; 1.05M-token context (922K input, 128K output); reasoning effort low to max
note: Microsoft AI's MAI Code 2 Flash, released Nov 17, 2026 (model card) in GitHub Copilot, billed per token under usage-based billing. The smaller, low-latency sibling of MAI Code 2, available on every Copilot plan and in limited-access preview on Microsoft Foundry. 12B active parameters (stated consistently); total is left null because the card's summary says '5B-15B' while Section 1 says about 398B. Price is GitHub's promotional rate ($0.05/$0.25 per Mtok) until May 17, 2027, then $0.1/$0.5, following the Gemini 4 Carbon precedent of filing the current introductory headline price. Weights are not distributed (model card). Predecessor is null: the card compares the family with MAI-Code-1.1-Flash, which is not in this corpus and is a different family. Rows come from the model card's quality table (Section 3: MSBench with the GitHub Copilot CLI harness, subagents off, max reasoning, pass rate) plus GPQA from its CBRN evaluation table (settings not stated). NOT FILED: SWE Atlas 44.8 (the full three-workflow benchmark, not the Codebase QnA column); the card's advanced-autonomy table gives different DeepSWE 1.1 (27.4) and SWE Atlas (65.2) figures and GAIA 56.36, and its loss-of-control table gives Terminal-Bench 4 2.5, all under unstated settings, so they are left out; the launch post's comparisons are relative only. Not on Vals AI yet.
